gold: OmniDocBench figure polygons normalized by official page dimensions
predicted: MinerU top-level image and chart normalized bboxes
matching: maximum cardinality bipartite matching at IoU>=0.5
denominators: all 12 pages per original/scan variant, include failed parses and false positives on pages without figures
excluded_before_scoring: degraded image coordinates need additional registration; no figure metric for that variant
